entities.name: Kodama of the West Tree
entities.description: Gloomy, feral kami of the Autumn Tree in the Jukai, one of the Five Trees, hating Towashi.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest of Kamigawa where the kodama dwells.

entities.name: Five Trees
entities.description: The sacred trees of the Jukai.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City the kodama passionately hates and prowls near.

relations.note: Passionate hatred of the city and all within.
relations.quote: It has a passionate hatred of Towashi and all who live within it

relations.note: Kami of the Autumn Tree in the Jukai forest.
relations.quote: The Kodama of the West Tree is the Kami of the Autumn Tree in the Jukai forest
